children: Otis Worldwide Corp reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.91 billion, net income of $414 million and diluted EPS of $1.08, increases of 6.1%, 10.7% and 13.7%, respectively, from the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Otis Worldwide Corporation”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Third-quarter Service sales increased 7% year over year, while New Equipment sales rose 3%.
For the first nine months, Service sales grew 10%, including 19% growth in modernization and 8% in maintenance and repair.
Nine-month New Equipment sales increased 1%, with growth in the Americas and EMEA offset by a decline of more than 20% in China.
Higher labor, material and organizational initiative costs pressured margins. New Equipment profit declined, while Service profit increased.
UpLift had generated about $200 million in run-rate savings by year-end 2025; restructuring and operating-model changes are ongoing.
